env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC credentials, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. This eval builds, deploys, and validates an RT-CV detection/tracking delta from the current `search` developer profile. The build label is `in-2`, never a Compose profile. Detection events must reach Kafka topic `mdx-raw` and Elasticsearch; streamed and uploaded media must remain retrievable through VIOS. Embeddings, Search analytics/API, Agent/UI/ingress, tracing, RT-VLM critique, and LLM inference are explicitly excluded.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-agent` to build this deployment under `_builds/in-2/`: "Provide streaming and on-demand object detection and multi-object tracking for class `person` using RT-DETR on RT-CV. Keep streamed and uploaded video retrievable through VIOS. Publish bounding boxes, class labels, confidence, timestamps, sensor IDs, and track IDs to Kafka and store them in Elasticsearch." Target `{{platform}}`, use the current `search` developer profile as the Foundation, retain the VIOS, RT-CV, Kafka, Logstash, Elasticsearch, and Kibana/dashboard services needed for this detection metadata profile, remove Search analytics/API, RT-Embed, RT-VLM critique, Agent/UI/ingress/tracing, and LLM services, set `ENABLE_CRITIC=false`, keep generated SDRC scratch/config files under `_builds/in-2/generated/` or `VSS_DATA_DIR` rather than under `deploy/docker/`, validate the resolved Compose configuration, and do not deploy.
checks: `{{repo_root}}/_builds/in-2/override.env` exists and declares `FOUNDATION=search` and the full effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES`.

Ignoring order, the effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES` equals exactly `kibana-init-container-search,nvstreamer-2d-fusion,perception-2d-init,perception-2d-fusion,elasticsearch,elasticsearch-init-container,kafka,kafka-topic-init-container,redis,kibana,logstash,broker-health-check,init-dirs,render-config,wdm-env-from-config,wait-for-redis,wait-for-docker-workloads,sdr-controller,centralizedb,vst-ingress,sensor-ms,streamprocessing-ms`.

The exact set therefore excludes `rtvi-embed`, `rtvi-vlm`, `vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion`, `vss-video-analytics-api-fusion`, `vss-agent`, `vss-ui`, `vss-haproxy-ingress`, `phoenix`, and LLM NIM keys.
`perception-2d-fusion` is used as the RT-CV key; `perception-2d` and `perception-alerts` are not substituted.
`COMPOSE_PROFILES` contains no `in-2`, aggregate, `bp_developer_*`, or other invented profile key.

The delta contains the requested environment changes such as `HARDWARE_PROFILE=RTXPRO6000BW`, `ENABLE_CRITIC=false`, RT-CV model/device settings, source count, paths, and reachable host values; it does not use a copied Search `.env` or `overrides.env` file as the delta artifact.

`_builds/in-2/compose.yml` includes `../../deploy/docker/compose.yml`; if `_builds/in-2/patches/` exists, it contains only minimal service entries needed to redirect generated writable bind sources away from `deploy/docker/`, not copied Foundation services.

The build directory contains the three required primary artifacts (`override.env`, `compose.yml`, and `resolved.yml`) and no copied Foundation `.env`, copied root Compose project, patched tree, manifest, allow-list, or generated skill bundle; build-local generated scratch/config outputs, if needed, live under `_builds/in-2/generated/`.

Resolution uses `containers.env`, Search `.env`, Search `overrides.env`, and `_builds/in-2/override.env`, in that order, with the build `compose.yml`; normalized `resolved.yml` validates directly, required peers resolve, excluded services do not resolve, no selected profile token is unknown, no service retains a `profiles:` gate, no real unescaped `${...}` Compose interpolation remains unresolved, escaped `$${...}` container-shell variables are not counted as unresolved interpolation, no `/path/to/deploy/docker` or `<HOST_IP>` sentinel remains, and every checked-in bind source exists with the expected file/directory type.
No file or directory under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is created, modified, or deleted.

expects.query: Deploy the validated `_builds/in-2/resolved.yml`, wait for selected services to become ready, and leave the deployment running for runtime validation.
checks: Deployment uses the validated `_builds/in-2/resolved.yml` as the only Compose file and starts it with `docker compose ... up -d`; harmless deployment options such as `-p <project>` or `--build` are allowed, but it must not re-read Foundation env files, supply `--profile`, use an invented Compose profile, or deploy a copied Compose project.
All selected long-running containers are running or healthy, all selected one-shot containers exit 0, and excluded services are not running.
`curl -sf http://localhost:${RTVI_CV_HOST_PORT:-9000}/ready` returns HTTP 200, and RT-CV reports the requested RT-DETR/person configuration.
Elasticsearch cluster health, Kafka broker/topic readiness, and VIOS APIs become reachable.

expects.query: Validate IN-2 end to end. Use an available warehouse sample video, prove uploaded and streamed media remain retrievable through VIOS, confirm RT-CV publishes `mdx-raw` metadata, and confirm Elasticsearch indexes detection/tracking documents. Report evidence and leave services running unless cleanup is explicitly requested.
checks: An uploaded warehouse video is retrievable through VIOS playback or clip APIs.
A live NvStreamer source is registered with VIOS and RT-CV is driven from the actual VIOS live-proxy RTSP URL discovered at runtime.
Kafka `mdx-raw` end offsets are recorded before and after live processing and increase.
Elasticsearch contains RT-CV metadata attributable to the processed sensor, including bounding boxes, class labels, confidence, timestamps, sensor IDs, and track IDs.

No file or directory under `{{repo_root}}/deploy/docker/` is created, modified, or deleted, and the final response reports the Foundation, effective delta, changed knobs, readiness, playback, Kafka, and Elasticsearch evidence.
